cues.title: 光子能量怎样变成质量
cues.caption: 总动量也要计入，才能重建质量。
cues.captionEn: Mass requires total momentum as well as energy.
cues.zh: 看量能器里的两处沉积：两个光子没有留下内层带电轨迹。先把能量相加，再合成方向相反的动量。母粒子运动时，两束光子的能量变得不等；总能量增加，重建质量却仍是一百二十五吉电子伏每光速平方。这是运动学示例，单个候选还不是发现。
cues.en: Two calorimeter deposits reveal photons, with no charged inner tracks. Add their energies and their vector momenta. A moving parent gives unequal photon energies: total energy increases, yet the reconstructed mass stays one hundred twenty-five gigaelectron-volts per c squared. This is a kinematic example; one candidate is not a discovery.

cues.title: 同一质量尺度反复出现
cues.caption: 固定观测记录检验拟合，再比较另一探测器。
cues.captionEn: Keep the data fixed; check another detector.
cues.zh: 金点是ATLAS发表图的近似读数。减去联合拟合的背景分量，一百二十五附近还有额外事件；加入共振峰可以解释这个结构。先留下问题：另一台探测器会看到吗？CMS也报告了相近质量的新粒子。两组记录分别取得；这张简图不能算出发现显著性。
cues.en: Gold points are approximate readings of the published ATLAS figure. Subtract the background component of its joint fit: an excess remains near one hundred twenty-five. A resonance explains that structure. Would another detector see it? CMS independently reported a nearby mass. These small plots do not reproduce discovery significance.

cues.title: 先看到额外吸收
cues.caption: 某些高能γ射线的透过信号，比简单基线预期更弱。
cues.captionEn: Some energetic gamma-ray transmission is weaker than a simple baseline predicts.
cues.zh: 赵忠尧的早期研究发现伽马射线的反常吸收和额外散射。先比较透射信号与原有解释的预期：异常是一条需要进一步核查的线索。页面用简化基线与附加吸收作对照，不声称复原当年的吸收系数或原始数据。
cues.en: Chao’s early work found anomalous gamma absorption and additional scattering. Compare transmission with an existing expectation: an anomaly is evidence requiring further investigation. The baseline and added absorption here are illustrative, not reconstructed historical coefficients or data.

cues.title: 后来用成对产生解释线索
cues.titleEn: Later interpret the clue through pair creation
cues.caption: 超过能量阈值后，光子可在核场中产生电子与正电子。
cues.captionEn: Above threshold, a photon can create an electron–positron pair in a nuclear field.
cues.zh: 后来建立的理论把这些线索与电子、正电子的成对产生和湮灭联系起来。产生一对粒子至少需要两份电子静能，核的反冲参与动量收支。不能把早期异常直接说成已经看到了正电子。画面下方是后来的过程解释。
cues.en: Later theory connected such clues with electron–positron pair creation and annihilation. Creating the pair requires at least two electron rest energies; nuclear recoil participates in momentum balance. The early anomaly was not direct observation of a positron. The lower view is a later process interpretation.

cues.title: K俘获后，核为什么反冲
cues.titleEn: Why does the nucleus recoil after electron capture?
cues.caption: 捕获内层电子后，发出的中微子带走动量，子核反向运动。
cues.captionEn: After inner-electron capture, a neutrino carries momentum and the daughter recoils.
cues.zh: 王淦昌提出利用K俘获后的核反冲检验中微子。以铍七为例，核捕获内层电子后变成锂七，并发出中微子。若中微子带走动量，子核就应反向反冲。虚线表示不可见粒子的推断方向，不代表探测器直接抓到了它。
cues.en: Wang proposed testing neutrinos through recoil following K capture. Beryllium seven captures an inner electron, producing lithium seven and a neutrino. Momentum carried away implies opposite nuclear recoil. The dashed direction is inferred; the detector does not directly capture the neutrino.

cues.title: 用阻挡电势读出反冲尺度
cues.titleEn: Probe recoil with a retarding potential
cues.caption: 反冲离子能否越过电势门槛，提供动能的信息。
cues.captionEn: Whether recoil ions cross a retarding barrier constrains their kinetic energy.
cues.zh: 后续反冲实验把微小动能转为可测的离子信号。升高阻挡电势，能通过的离子减少。所选基态支的反冲能约五十七电子伏。这里是假设单电荷离子和理想平面电场的补充模型，忽略原子退激发、其他衰变支和表面效应。
cues.en: Later experiments turned small recoil energies into measurable ion signals. A higher retarding potential transmits fewer ions. The selected ground-state branch gives about fifty-seven electron-volts. This supplementary model assumes singly charged ions and a planar field, omitting atomic relaxation, other branches and surface effects.

cues.title: 弯曲和缺失动量留下什么线索
cues.titleEn: What curvature and missing momentum reveal
cues.caption: 正电母粒子留下正电介子，仍有动量缺口。
cues.captionEn: A positive parent leaves a positive pion—and missing momentum.
cues.zh: 这条母粒子轨迹带正电，衰变后继续的是正电派介子。电荷账本允许另一个产物不带电，但可见介子带不走全部动量。把两条切线的动量作差，得到缺失方向。随后，远处B点出现新的相互作用。A到B之间没有连续气泡，是中性路径的线索。
cues.en: The parent track is positive, and the departing pion is positive too. Charge balance allows a neutral product, but the pion does not carry all the momentum. Subtract the tangent momentum vectors to infer a missing direction. A later interaction at B, with no continuous bubble trail from A, supplies another constraint.

cues.title: 中子还是反中子
cues.caption: A 点约束质量；B 点的能量提供新的区分。
cues.captionEn: A constrains the mass; B supplies new energy evidence.
cues.zh: 用实测AB方向参与动量重建，可得到约一点一八吉电子伏的母粒子质量。但质量和电荷不能区分中子与反中子。B点已测产物的最低能量约一千四百八十三兆电子伏，超过普通中子约九百四十的动能。反中子湮灭可以释放额外静能，支持这个关联解释。
cues.en: Using the measured AB direction reconstructs the parent mass near one-point-one-eight gigaelectron-volts. Mass and charge alone cannot distinguish neutron from antineutron. At B, the measured product-energy minimum exceeds the ordinary neutron’s kinetic energy. Antineutron annihilation can release additional rest energy, supporting the linked interpretation.

cues.title: 先建立核自旋方向
cues.caption: 核极化程度改变，电子计数的不对称也改变。
cues.captionEn: Changing nuclear polarization changes the counting asymmetry.
cues.zh: 吴健雄与合作者在低温条件下极化钴六十核，建立可比较的自旋方向。比较沿自旋与反方向的贝塔电子计数，发现不对称。极化消失时，这种方向差异也消失。页面用归一化角分布表达规律，不模拟低温装置的热学过程。
cues.en: Wu and collaborators polarized cobalt-sixty nuclei at low temperature. Beta counts along and opposite the spin direction were unequal. Removing polarization removes the directional asymmetry. A normalized angular model illustrates the result without simulating the cryogenic apparatus or reproducing its measured counting efficiency.

cues.title: 比较整个过程的空间反演
cues.caption: 空间反演改变电子动量方向，自旋方向保持不变。
cues.captionEn: Spatial inversion reverses electron momentum while leaving spin unchanged.
cues.zh: 把整个过程作空间反演。电子动量反向，但自旋是轴矢量，在空间反演下不变。如果两种过程完全等价，沿自旋与反方向就不应有这种偏好。实验的不对称表明这一弱相互作用过程不守恒宇称，不是说所有物理过程都失去镜像对称。
cues.en: Under spatial inversion, electron momentum reverses but axial-vector spin does not. Equivalent reflected processes would not show this directional preference. The observed asymmetry demonstrates parity violation in this weak process. It does not claim that every physical interaction lacks reflection symmetry.

cues.title: 改磁场，质量峰应怎样变
cues.titleEn: What should a changed field do to the mass peak?
cues.caption: 磁场改变轨迹，正确重建的质量应保持。
cues.captionEn: The field changes tracks, not a correctly reconstructed mass.
cues.zh: 先看电子对：已知磁场和曲率，就能求出动量，再合成母粒子质量。把磁场减小，弯曲半径变大，正确重建的质量应保持。丁肇中团队改变谱仪设定，让粒子走过不同位置。揭开第二组历史记录，质量仍集中在三点一附近，支持真实粒子的解释。
cues.en: Known field and curvature give the electron pair’s momenta, then its parent mass. A weaker field increases the bending radii; correct reconstruction should preserve mass. Ting’s team changed the spectrometer setting so tracks passed through different detector regions. Reveal the second historical sample: it still concentrates near three-point-one, supporting a real particle.

cues.title: 用对撞能量再找一次
cues.titleEn: Find it again by scanning collision energy
cues.caption: 对撞质心能量扫描给出另一条证据链。
cues.captionEn: A collision-energy scan supplies a different evidence chain.
cues.zh: 换一种测法。两束等能量的正负电子迎面相撞，总动量抵消，质心能量是单束的两倍。里克特团队扫描能量，强子截面在三点一附近骤增。这与固定靶重建质量是不同测量，却指向相近尺度。图上的宽度受束流与仪器影响，不等于自然线宽。
cues.en: Try a different measurement. Equal electron and positron beams collide head-on, cancelling momentum: center-of-mass energy is twice one beam’s energy. Richter’s scan shows a sharp rise in hadronic cross section near three-point-one. This differs from pair-mass reconstruction but supports the same scale. Observed width includes beam and detector effects.
